title: EgocentricHeritageVandalismAnnotation
description: Annotation record for video action recognition in heritage wall protection

video_id.description: Unique identifier for the video clip (e.g. SHA-256 or clip ID)

file_name.description: Base filename of the video clip

action_label.description: Action class according to the heritage protection taxonomy

start_sec.description: Optional start timestamp in seconds for the action event

end_sec.description: Optional end timestamp in seconds for the action event

is_egocentric.description: True if filmed from a first-person / body-worn camera perspective

watermark_detected.description: Whether a stock or camera watermark is present in the frame

tool_used.description: Object or tool involved in the physical interaction

target_surface.description: Type of architectural or monument substrate

verified_by_human.description: Must be true; labels must never be assigned based on filename alone

annotator_id.description: Identifier of the human annotator or domain reviewer

notes.description: Additional domain observations or edge cases
